cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.26% · WTI +2.77% · Brent +3.53% · NatGas +3.98%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Refining & Downstream is doing the heavy lifting at +2.65%.

cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +2.65%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -1.14%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SEDG is the standout at -7.72%
cards.body: Leaders: EQNR +3.99%, VLO +3.38%, DVN +3.14%, APA +2.87%, MPC +2.75%. Laggards: SEDG -7.72%, EOSE -7.29%, ARRY -7.11%, RUN -6.62%.
